title: Coles investigating ‘cybersecurity incident’ and apologises to customers
byline: Australian Associated Press; Guardian staff reporter
paragraphs: Australia’s second-largest retailer has been targeted in a cyber-attack, though it is still too early to tell whether any of its data has been stolen or compromised.
Coles revealed the threat on Monday morning, saying it was investigating the incident with support from the Australian Cyber Security Centre and global security experts.
“Coles Group Limited is currently investigating a cyber security incident,” the company said in a statement to the stock exchange.
